tickets.title: Carry the validated session identity through the public API

authority.requirement: The public API carries the validated session identity and refuses a conflicting identity before any state mutation.

tickets.outcome: Both public entry points use the validated session identity and reject conflicts before writing state.

criteria.observable: A matching identity reaches both entry points and produces the same persisted subject identifier.
criteria.proof: The T01 acceptance test drives both mounted entry points against the local persistence adapter.

criteria.observable: A conflicting identity is refused and the before-and-after state snapshots are identical.
criteria.proof: The T01 negative case records the state snapshot before and after the refused request.

criteria.observable: The selected identity precedence is the ratified server-validated-session rule.
criteria.proof: Decision D1 names the ratified authority and its implementation effect.

criteria.observable: The production browser presents the validated session identity through both deployed hosts.
criteria.proof: The deployment owner records the two-host browser walkthrough against the released artifact.

existingEvidence.description: The baseline reproduces the conflicting-identity write on the second entry point.

remainingWork: Route both entry points through the validated session identity boundary.
Add the state-preservation assertion for a refused conflicting identity.

decisions.effect: The server-validated session identity takes precedence and conflicting client identity input is refused.

deferredLiveAcceptance.description: Run the released browser flow through both deployed hosts.
deferredLiveAcceptance.proof: A release-stamped walkthrough records the subject identifier and refusal result from both hosts.

tickets.title: Make event ingestion idempotent before applying the cap

authority.requirement: Logical event identity is deduplicated before any cap, and a retry cannot consume capacity twice.

tickets.outcome: The ingestion path deduplicates logical event identity before capacity accounting on original and retry requests.

criteria.observable: An original event and its retry consume one capacity position and produce one durable record.
criteria.proof: The T02 acceptance test submits both requests through the mounted ingestion route and reads the durable record count.

criteria.observable: Two different event identities consume two capacity positions.
criteria.proof: The T02 positive control changes only the logical identity and observes two durable records.

remainingWork: Move logical-identity deduplication ahead of capacity accounting.
Prove retry and distinct-identity behavior through the mounted ingestion route.
doneWhen: The frozen T02 acceptance command returns PASS at the recorded artifact revision.
The program integration gate returns PASS once at the same artifact revision.
A verifier distinct from the implementation actor records PASS.

tickets.title: Keep custom overlays separate from canonical reports

authority.requirement: A custom overlay never overwrites the canonical report, including during concurrent writes.

tickets.outcome: Custom overlay evaluation cannot alter the canonical report or its revision under sequential or concurrent execution.

criteria.observable: Canonical report bytes and revision are unchanged after custom overlay evaluation.
criteria.proof: The T03 acceptance test compares canonical reads before and after overlay evaluation.

criteria.observable: Concurrent canonical publication and overlay evaluation preserve the canonical publication result.
criteria.proof: The T03 concurrency case controls both operations and reads the winning canonical revision.

remainingWork: Separate overlay result identity from canonical report identity.
Add the controlled concurrent-publication acceptance case.
